text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the BNW showdown
is... Narita
Taishin! Narita Taishin is
victorious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Nice. That wasn't bad at all. I feel
good.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I guess winning races really is what I
want. I want
to keep winning until I can
truly believe in
myself.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I had no idea winning could make me
feel so
happy...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nooooo! I was running at my fullest of
full power,
but I still lost!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm sad for myself... but happy for you,
Taishin!
Congratulatiooons!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're our dear rival for good reason.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm almost dumbfounded at how great
you are!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well... It's only because I've got you
guys.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin rises to the top of BNW
amid
seemingly endless waves of cheers
and praise for
her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I wanna talk to you about my next
race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Would it kill you to act like a normal
person for
once? Anyway...
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, which one will it be?!
Yeah, which one do you want?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've come this far, there's one
race I
definitely wanna run in, and that's
the Grand Prix
at the end of the year—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm pretty sure both Ticket and
Hayahide
will be entering it, so I might
as well too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I want to push myself and see what I'm
really
made of.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I want to test this strength of mine that
you
believe in so much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is now set for the Arima
Kinen!
